roleInfo.name: Guide
roleInfo.description: You wrote the clues — sit back and watch.

params.name: format
params.value: ($1) — in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!

params.name: format
params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.text: Cooperative word-puzzle. Each round, one player is the Guide. They get 4 cards (each card has 4 words). They write 4 single-word clues — one per pair of adjacent cards — linking the two words that face each other.

Then the cards get shuffled and rotated randomly. The other players use the controls on the right (rotate CW, rotate CCW, swap) to put the cards back in their original positions and orientations. Hit END ROUND when you're ready — needs majority. Score: +1 grid solved for a perfect 4/4. Green = correct, blue = correct spot but wrong rotation, red = wrong spot.

params.name: format
params.value: ($1), tap whoever is writing the clues this round.

params.name: format
